questions.prompt: Explain the performance mistake snapshot 11 starts from: what the incident list did before, and how its cost was measured.

keyPoints.text: Before the fix, linked ticket summaries were fetched incident by incident.
keyPoints.quote: The incident list previously fetched linked ticket summaries one incident at a time.

keyPoints.text: The before code looped over linked ticket IDs calling getById each time.
Five incidents with three tickets each meant fifteen extra ticket calls after the list query.
The cost was measured by counting repository calls during GET /api/incidents.
The lesson asks you to predict the call count for the before version first.
keyPoints.quote: Predict how many repository calls happen when five incidents each link three tickets in the before version.

questions.prompt: Explain how the fix works: which interface changed, which code makes the batched call, and how the results are stitched back onto each incident.

keyPoints.text: The TicketRepository interface gained a batched lookup by many IDs.
The in-memory repository answers the batch with one filter over a Set of IDs.
OperationsService first collects the unique linked ticket IDs across all incidents.
It then calls getByIds once and indexes the tickets in a Map by id.
Each incident's summaries are built from the map, skipping IDs that no longer exist.
The composition root now passes TicketRepository into OperationsService.

questions.prompt: Explain the design decisions behind the fix and what the snapshot deliberately leaves for later.

keyPoints.text: Performance work belongs near data access, so the repository interface changed rather than the controller.
keyPoints.quote: Fix the repository interface instead of hiding loops in the controller because performance belongs near data access.

keyPoints.text: A measurement script and comment stay in the code so the reason for the refactor is visible.
keyPoints.quote: Keep a measurement script and comment so the junior sees why the refactor happened.

keyPoints.text: Responses carry summary DTOs, not whole tickets, to keep payloads from growing by accident.
keyPoints.quote: Return summary DTOs instead of full tickets to avoid accidental payload growth.

keyPoints.text: The linked-ticket summary DTO exposes only id, title and status.
Search, filters and pagination are deferred to the next snapshot.
keyPoints.quote: Snapshot 12 adds search, filters, and pagination.
